subject: Private Offer: Finaira — term options & approvals (AWS Marketplace)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Adam Lewis <adam.lewis@finaira.com>, Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@finaira.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private Offer: Finaira — term options & approvals (AWS Marketplace)

Hi Adam / Sarah,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to hear Finaira is ready to pilot the model in payments risk scoring. To move towards a private offer on AWS Marketplace, we typically align on three items up front: pricing tiers, term length, and the buyer approval matrix (who signs / who needs procurement vs finance).

High-level options we can support for a private offer:
- 12-month annual commitment (best unit price)
- 24-month discounted commit (further 8-12% off list)
- Monthly pay-as-you-go for pilots (shorter activation window, higher unit rate)

Questions for you:
1) Which legal/finance contacts must sign the PO? (CFO, Head of Procurement, business owner?)
2) Do you need a 30/60/90-day PO issuance window after offer acceptance?
3) Any technical/evidence gating (SOC2, data residency) we should attach up front?

I attached our private offer template and a short SOC2 summary for legal — happy to swap in specific evidence docs if your team needs them. If it helps, I can propose a 2-week approval calendar that shows windows for legal review, procurement signoff, and activation.

Proposed next step: 30-minute alignment with your procurement + legal to confirm approvers and target activation date. Are you available Thurs afternoon?

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_private_offer_template.pdf (PDF), soc2-evidence-summary.zip (ZIP)
From: Adam Lewis <adam.lewis@finaira.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@finaira.com>, procurement@finaira.com
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private Offer: Finaira — term options & approvals (AWS Marketplace)

Tessa — thanks, this is helpful. Quick answers / clarifications from our side: 

- Signatories: CFO (L. Mercer) signs for commitments >$250k; procurement can accept PO <= $250k. Business owner (my manager) signs off on license scope.
- PO window: we prefer 60 days but can stretch to 90 if needed for legal reviews.
- Evidence: Sarah (cc) will want the SOC2 report and an engineer-facing diagram of data flow.

Couple of asks:
1) Can Redwood split a single private offer across two departments (Payments and Risk) under one PO?
2) What volume band discounts look like between 500k and 2M tokens/month (ballpark) — we just need a starting point so our finance team can model.

Sarah — I'll let you add anything I missed. We can do Thurs 3pm PT for the procurement alignment if that works for you, Tessa.

Thanks,
Adam
Adam Lewis | Head of Data Products, Finaira
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2028 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Private Offer: Finaira — term options & approvals (AWS Marketplace)

Tessa / team — looping in quick recommendations so we can respond with concrete numbers tomorrow: 

Summary proposal (internal):
- Option A (pilot / PAYG): monthly usage, no long-term commitment. Unit price = list_x. Good for validation but higher cost.
- Option B (12m commit): 12-month commitment, 10% off list after first 250k tokens/month; includes one free onboarding week and 1 SRE assist.
- Option C (24m commit): 24-month commitment, 18% off list + priority capacity and longer KV cache retention (product callout).

Approval/activation recommendations:
- Keep PO window at 60 days (Finaira prefers 60) — acceptable.
- Single PO supported across departments if finance provides internal cost-center allocation; we can model multi-account billing.
- For SOC2/data flow: attach soc2-evidence-summary.zip and produce an architecture diagram (I can ask infra to patch one).

Attachments for external send: Finaira_pricing_matrix.xlsx (pricing bands and token breakpoints), redwood_private_offer_template.pdf, soc2-evidence-summary.zip.

Questions for sales: what deal-level discount guidance do we want to present as a band vs a fixed number? I recommend a tiered band (500k–1M, 1M–2M, >2M) with ranges so procurement can model.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Dir, Marketplace & Strategic Deals, Redwood Inference
Attachments (internal): Finaira_pricing_matrix.xlsx
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Adam Lewis <adam.lewis@finaira.com>, Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@finaira.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 13 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private Offer: Finaira — term options & approvals (AWS Marketplace)

Adam / Sarah — thanks for the details — below is a concise calendar and the pricing bands we propose.

Proposed 2-week approval calendar (example):
- Day 0 (Thu 13 Jun): Redwood sends private offer + SOC2 summary + pricing bands (attached).
- Day 1–3: Finaira legal & procurement review; list clarifying questions.
- Day 4–7: Redwood responds; legal exchange if needed.
- Day 8–12: Procurement signoff window (internal approvals: CFO or procurement depending on band).
- Day 13–14: DocuSign & activation.

Pricing bands (ballpark — finalized on call):
- 500k–1M tokens/month: $0.0055 / token (12m commit)
- 1M–2M tokens/month: $0.0049 / token (12m commit)
- >2M tokens/month: contact sales for tiered discount (we can offer 12–18% off list on 24m)

We can support a 60-day PO issuance window and a single PO across departments (we'll set up internal billing allocation). I've attached the pricing matrix and the filled private offer template for your procurement team to review.

DocuSign link (draft envelope): https://docusign.com/envelopes/ABC-7552
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/finaira

Can we confirm Thurs 3pm PT for the procurement alignment? If yes, I'll include Karina from our finance ops in the invite.

Best,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Finaira_pricing_matrix.xlsx, redwood_private_offer_template.pdf, soc2-evidence-summary.zip
From: Adam Lewis <adam.lewis@finaira.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@finaira.com>
Cc: procurement@finaira.com
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 15:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private Offer: Finaira — term options & approvals (AWS Marketplace)

Tessa — thanks, the calendar and bands look good. Confirming Thurs 3pm PT for the procurement sync. A few quick notes before the call: 

- We will aim for a 60-day PO window.
- We will likely target the 1M–2M band for initial pilot ramp; please have a final quote for that band ready for the meeting.
- Legal will want the SOC2 report (not just a summary) — Sarah will share the intake form in the meeting.
- Can Redwood start basic onboarding (technical kickoff, provisioning test account) before PO is fully executed? That would help shorten time to value.

If you can confirm onboarding yes/no on the call, we can proceed. See you Thursday.

Thanks,
Adam
Adam Lewis | Head of Data Products, Finaira
